note: The Rheolith kit's adapter onto the material library (biomes/rheolith/PLAN.md section 7.3). Five KGROUND layers on the Breached Throat graben (84-host-ground.js), keeping active samplers well below 16: the rift floor's dark cinder and ash (ground.cinder), the persistent pahoehoe lava-crust bench over the foam-reef keel (ground.crust -> ground.lava.crust), the fumaroles' zeolite sinter aprons (ground.sinter), the white fluoride etch-frost and sulfate bloom (ground.efflorescence), and the fault scarps' flow-banded basalt (ground.basalt -> rock.basalt.flowbanded). Run python3 tools/textures/pack.py biomes/rheolith after any change, then python3 tools/build.py biomes/rheolith.
